title: Chicken and rice casserole
subtitle: Bone-in chicken baked over rice in a simple cream sauce
excerpt: Chicken and rice casserole is bone-in chicken pieces laid over raw long-grain rice in a baking dish with chicken stock and a little cream, then covered and baked until the rice has absorbed the liquid and the chicken is cooked through. A proper hands-off one-dish supper that bakes in 45 minutes.
sourceNotes: American home-cooking tradition. Chicken and rice casserole appears in mid-twentieth-century American cookbooks including Joy of Cooking and in Fannie Farmer (later editions). The one-pan method of baking chicken over uncooked rice has been a staple of American church-potluck cooking since the 1950s.

recipe.makeAheadNotes: Assemble up to 4 hours ahead and refrigerate unbaked. Add 10 minutes to the covered baking time.

content.text: Chicken and rice casserole puts raw long-grain rice in a baking dish, sets bone-in chicken pieces on top, and covers everything with seasoned chicken stock. The oven does the rest: the rice absorbs the liquid as it cooks and the chicken finishes simultaneously. The result is moist chicken sitting on tender, flavour-soaked rice.

Heat the oven to 180°C. Butter the roasting dish generously. Scatter the {{onion}} onion, {{garlic}} of garlic, and {{thyme-dried}} of dried thyme over the base. Stir in the rinsed {{long-grain-rice}} of rice. Mix {{stock-chicken}} of warm stock with {{double-cream}} of cream and pour over the rice.

Season the {{chicken-thigh}} chicken thighs and {{chicken-drumsticks}} drumsticks with salt, pepper, {{paprika-smoked}} of smoked paprika, and {{garlic-powder}} of garlic powder. Lay them skin-side up over the rice. Cover tightly with foil.
Bake covered for 35 minutes. Remove the foil and bake for a further 15 minutes until the chicken skin is golden and the internal temperature reads 75°C. Rest for 5 minutes before serving.

items.symptom: Rice not cooked after baking time
items.cause: Too little liquid or oven temperature too low.
items.fix: Cover and bake for a further 10 minutes with a little more warm stock added.

items.cause: Oven too hot or dish too thin.
items.fix: Keep the oven at 180°C and use a deep roasting dish. The foil cover for the first 35 minutes prevents the top from drying before the base is cooked.

content.text: The original mid-century version uses a tin of condensed cream of mushroom soup in place of the stock and cream. Frozen peas or sliced mushrooms stirred into the rice before baking add colour and substance. Brown rice needs a longer bake: add 15 minutes and extra stock.

Chicken and rice casserole is one of the defining American church-potluck dishes, made in a large foil tray and brought to the table still warm. The hands-off bake suits a busy household, which explains its steady presence in American home cookbooks for decades.
